train_window: 2011-01-04 through 2016-03-29; old Valid 2016-04-01 through 2026-07-31 as development
confirmation_policy: Historical Valid is already opened and development data; paper OOS is future-only.
trials: Phase 1: fixed H1 mechanical audit only; no target/P&L/RankIC reads
Phase 2: fixed age/event-lag descriptive diagnostics; no threshold selection
Phase 3: at most 3 exact interventions preregistered and hash-locked before candidate P&L
feature_definitions: Existing dm_variable_box_breakout features, event masks, and fixed H1 score stream; no new predictor.
model: Existing yearly walk-forward Ridge H1, lambda=1.0; stored models reused without refit.

parameters.sn1_source_precedence: negative low_state, else positive high_state only when low_state==0, else D

selection_rule: Structural mechanism and P/L attribution must agree; Train and historical Valid direction broadly consistent; no retrospective threshold search. If no intervention survives, retain SN1_H1.
allowed_inputs: Train and historical-Valid one-day targets only after Phase 1 lock
